and ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T1 WHERE T1.SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND T1.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource} AND T1.VALUE_DATE < to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 WHERE T2.SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND T2.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource} AND T2.VALUE_DATE < to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND t2.VALUE_DATE > t1.VALUE_DATE )

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id,
T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ' | ' ||T1.FINPROD_ABBR text,
T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT,
T2.TYPE_4, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11,
T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{assestType} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_05},#{TRADE_PLACE_09},#{TRADE_PLACE_10})
